content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

This infrastructure is a sovereign digital commerce stack designed specifically for creators in markets like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments, you can create a fully operational online store that bypasses traditional payment systems. This matters because it empowers creators to maintain control over their work and revenue without the burden of high transaction fees and dependency on third-party platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this stack utilizes a combination of free and low-cost tools to facilitate the sale of digital products. For hosting, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the foundation. The backend logic is executed using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, while order processing and storage are managed through Supabase or Google Sheets. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a mere 0.5% fee, significantly less than platforms like Gumroad.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is built for digital creators who are currently facing barriers in monetizing their content due to restricted payment platforms. Whether you are an ebook author, a course creator, or a designer selling templates and fonts, this stack provides a reliable solution to accept payments in cryptocurrencies. The focus is on creators in regions such as Ethiopia, Venezuela, and other countries where traditional payment options are limited or overly expensive.
Say goodbye to high fees with NOWPayments' 0.5% transaction rate.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign digital commerce stack consists of various components that work in harmony. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages act as the storefront, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage backend operations. Order storage is facilitated via Supabase or Google Sheets, allowing easy access to transaction data. NOWPayments ensures that you can accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies, converting them to USD at transaction time. This seamless integration creates a straightforward and efficient sales process.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying your own sovereign digital commerce stack, first, choose your hosting platform—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to handle order storage, and integrate NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from COREMERCH, you can access all necessary blueprints and templates to launch your store immediately.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a sovereign digital commerce stack. This solution incorporates free hosting, backend management, and automated crypto payment processing. By using tools like NOWPayments, you can accept cryptocurrencies directly and avoid platform fees altogether, making your sales process efficient and cost-effective.
Take control of your sales process without relying on third-party platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those searching for ways to sell ebooks without platforms like PayPal or Gumroad, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers everything needed to deploy a sovereign commerce stack. Discover more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, where you can find blueprints tailored for your digital selling needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I accept payments for my digital products?

You can accept payments by integrating NOWPayments into your sovereign digital commerce stack. This allows you to process over 300 cryptocurrencies with low transaction fees and no account requirements.
Can I set up my store without coding experience?
Yes, the tools and templates included in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) are designed to be user-friendly, enabling you to launch your store even with minimal technical knowledge.
What are the transaction fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly less than platforms like Gumroad which charge 10%.
What kind of digital products can I sell?
You can sell a variety of digital products such as ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software using this architecture.
Is customer data secure with this setup?
Yes, using tools like Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage ensures that you have complete ownership and control over your customer data.
